verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product-analytics platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Pendo as a hosted service. Installation means embedding a JavaScript snippet, Launcher or SDK that sends data to Pendo, and Data Sync exports data out to a warehouse. Neither amounts to running the core product on your own infrastructure, and no self-hosted or on-prem deployment option is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
